name: Balance Scale Tip
easing: build EASE.inOut f0-14; cards EASE.out f6-24; tip: spring {damping:5,stiffness:70,mass:1} from f20, final angle 7° (right side down)
bestFor: Weighing two things where one clearly outweighs ('paper metrics vs real workloads').
script: f0-14: fulcrum triangle, base line and beam draw.
f6-24: strings and two pan-cards draw in (cards stay upright when the beam rotates).
f20+: the beam tips right with an under-damped spring, wobbles and settles at 7°.
colorRules: Right card orange (argued side), left card blue outline (contrast pair role). Beam cream.
